marks.gloss_en: rasha ('im bin hakot harasha') -- rasha ('asher hu rasha lamut'): as those liable to death are tried by twenty-three, so those liable to lashes
lashes are administered by a court of twenty-three
lashes are administered by a court of three
(entertained) vehitzdiku and vehirshi'u also count toward the tally of judges
the Torah's hint that conspiring witnesses receive lashes is 'they shall justify the righteous and condemn the wicked... if the wicked deserves to be beaten'
one is not lashed for a prohibition without an act -- so lo ta'aneh cannot supply the lashes of conspiring witnesses
R' Yishmael's reason is that lashes stand in place of death, so lashes are tried as a capital case
